movie_title: When This Number Hits 5200 - You Will be Dead
introduction:
Gain a new perspective on your life with our "Calendar & Timeline of Your Life Posters":
https://kgs
lead_intro: Life is like swimming in the ocean - full of distractions and decisions. Let's take a step back and look at the big picture. Are you making the most of your time?

quiz.question: How many weeks of life does the average person have at their disposal when they are born?
quiz.explanation: The average person has 5200 weeks of life at their disposal when they are born, according to the video.

quiz.question: At what age do most people start working for real?
quiz.explanation: Most people start working for real in their twenties at the latest, which marks the beginning of the productive period in their life.

quiz.question: At what age do people tend to work until?
quiz.explanation: People tend to work until the age of 65, which signifies spending a significant portion of life in serious adult work.

quiz.question: What is the average lifespan in the US?
quiz.explanation: The average lifespan in the US is 79 years, highlighting the limited time we have in our lives.

quiz.question: What visual tools were created by Kurzgesagt to help track how you spend your weeks?
quiz.explanation: Kurzgesagt created both the 'Calendar of Your Life' and the 'Timeline of Your Life' as visual reminders to track how you spend your weeks.
